name: Transfer Of Proceeds Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of transfer for the market claim proceeds.

CLFT.name: Full Transfer Of Received Proceeds
CLFT.definition: Market Claim is to transfer proceeds received from the issuer to the entitled party.

CLPT.name: No Transfer Of Received Proceeds
CLPT.definition: Market Claim is to compensate the entitled party in cash by the party that failed to fulfil its obligation. No proceeds have been received from the issuer.

CLNT.name: Partial Transfer Of Received Proceeds
CLNT.definition: Market Claim is to transfer proceeds partially received from the issuer to the entitled party. Part is compensated in cash by the party that failed to fulfil its obligation.
